mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at, COUNT(e.id) AS event_count FROM ledger_blocks b LEFT JOIN ledger_events e ON e.block_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at ORDER BY b.block_number DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at, COUNT(e.id) AS event_count FROM ledger_blocks b LEFT JOIN ledger_events e ON e.block_id = b.id WHERE b.block_number = #{blockNumber} GROUP BY b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at

SELECT b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at, COUNT(e.id) AS event_count FROM ledger_blocks b LEFT JOIN ledger_events e ON e.block_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at ORDER BY b.block_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at, COUNT(e.id) AS event_count FROM ledger_blocks b LEFT JOIN ledger_events e ON e.block_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.block_number, b.previous_hash, b.merkle_root, b.current_hash, b.created_at ORDER BY b.block_number ASC
SELECT id, block_id, transaction_hash, payload_hash, event_type, reference_type, reference_id, payload AS payload_json, created_at FROM ledger_events WHERE block_id = #{blockId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, block_id, transaction_hash, payload_hash, event_type, reference_type, reference_id, payload AS payload_json, created_at FROM ledger_events ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, block_id, transaction_hash, payload_hash, event_type, reference_type, reference_id, payload AS payload_json, created_at FROM ledger_events WHERE transaction_hash = #{transactionHash}
